Country profile: Valhalla

[P1] Valhalla is the second rice exporter in the region and also a miner. Its economy combines grain growing in the lowlands with copper and specialty-metal mining in the hills, giving it a more varied export base than Vanir.

[P2] The main exports are rice, copper ore and a small amount of specialty metals. The country imports machinery, much of it for mining and food processing. Rice and metal shipments leave through several commercial terminals rather than a single named hub.

[P3] Granite Mining, a copper miner, is the best-known firm. The mining sector supports engineering, haulage and repair businesses, while the rice trade is handled by a large number of independent growers and cooperatives. The two sectors use different roads and storage sites.

[P4] Mining towns in the hills are linked by haul roads to the coast, and processing plants sit near the pits. Rice farms in the lowlands use a separate network of smaller roads and stores.
